messages.subject: Project Drake — SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Please find attached the first draft of the Share Purchase Agreement for Project Drake. It reflects the agreed Heads of Terms — £42.5m EV, £3m escrow over 18 months, full warranty suite and tax covenant, with a 25% cap on general warranty claims and customary de minimis/threshold (£25k/£250k). Disclosure Letter to follow separately.

Look forward to your mark-up.

James
